summary: Defines two IKEv2 Configuration Payload Attribute Types, INTERNAL_DNS_DOMAIN and INTERNAL_DNSSEC_TA, that add support for private, internal-only DNS domains reachable through an IPsec connection. Other domains are resolved as before. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: When you join your company's network, this lets your computer use the company's phone book for company names, and your normal one for everything else.
